The Komatsu (bucket, KOMATSU on the counterweight) works close to D2 from 09:43 to 12:18, with a dense burst from 11:58 to 12:18. It is parked from 13:37. No tippers came. The machine at the far end is not seen working.

Saturday. The orange Hitachi breaks at the far end from 07:26 to about 09:29 (heavy dust at 08:23). It stays parked in one spot from 12:21 to 17:06. No tippers.
Sunday

The Komatsu works close to D2 almost continuously from 12:15 to after 13:13, through the lunch hour (69 events in the 13:00 hour). A machine works at the far end 14:19-15:40. No tippers. This is the busiest D2 day in the set (135 events).

Saturday. The orange Hitachi works at the far end 06:17-10:18; its position changes between tiles. One load: a yellow-bed tipper on D2 at 08:10, which reverses out at 08:22 (Entrance). After that, cars only. It rained from about 16:24 and again around 22:00. The night events on both cameras are rain streaks and a dog. Not suspicious.

machine swap on a lowboy 08:15-08:51 via the top road

The Komatsu works 09:16-13:37 and loads the green El Hajj truck beside D2 at 12:12-12:20. Three loads by the green El Hajj Mercedes, out at about 09:35, 10:46 and 12:22 (Entrance shows it loaded each time). The Hitachi stays parked at the far end.

The Komatsu works 10:28-11:25, then drives past D2 toward the entrance at 11:28-11:29, where the Entrance camera shows it. The orange Hitachi breaks continuously 12:36-15:38 (about 70 events). No tippers.

The Hitachi breaks 08:44-09:50 and 14:20-15:19. Nothing was recorded 09:50-13:59; the high estimate allows for work in that gap. The Komatsu is parked at the far end. No tippers. A Mhanna diesel tanker is on site 15:19-15:41.

The Komatsu works 09:58-10:21 and drives up past D2 to the entrance at 10:18-10:21 (also on Entrance). The Hitachi breaks 10:33-11:54, and again around 14:06 and 15:26. A bucket machine moves at 15:39-15:44. No tippers. One Entrance event at 01:00 was not inspected.

Hitachi idle all day

The Komatsu works almost continuously 10:13-15:20 (about 108 motion events). Four loads by white Mhanna tippers at about 10:31, 11:31, 11:55 and 12:34. D2 shows two of them (in 10:14 / out loaded 10:31, in 12:22 / out loaded 12:34); Entrance shows all four. A CIFA concrete pump came 08:01-08:03. The Hitachi is not seen working. The Entrance events from 19:00 to 22:00 are lights and dogs at the gate.

The Hitachi breaks 08:06-08:53 (d1 up), then 09:30-14:37 almost continuously on D2 (close to D2 at 12:01-12:11). This matches the Entrance camera at 09:30-14:48. The Komatsu is parked all day. No tippers.

Saturday. D2 recorded only 5 events: a dog, two sedans at 08:01 and 08:07, and the RAV4 at 10:37 and 13:59. Both machines are parked at the far end in every tile. Entrance shows cars only, plus people carrying branches at about 16:00. Its 150+ events from 17:00 to 23:00 are light changes and dogs.

d1 up was complete and D2_Up agrees (Hitachi breaking in the pit 11:25-15:53, rain stop visible; Komatsu loading at 09:16-09:34 and 10:37). 2 Scania loads (entrance out 09:34 and 10:53). D2's higher figures include the rain stop and the Komatsu's idle hour. No change.

d1 up has no footage 07:47-16:25. D2_Up shows the Komatsu working in the pit at 08:34 (one event only) and the Hitachi breaking at 09:23, 10:07, 11:06-11:49, 13:03, 13:56 and 15:53, then parked by 15:57; D2 sees it 11:03-15:53. Estimate: Hitachi about 09:00-15:55 less about 1 h lunch (range 4.5-6.5 h); Komatsu one short session (range 0.2-1.0 h). No trucks on any camera.

d1 up stops at 07:19. D2_Up + D2: Hitachi breaking from about 09:30 (09:50, 10:26-10:58) to 12:47, 13:34-13:51 and 15:21-15:58; idle in the rain 13:50-15:00 (the Dodge against it 14:45-14:58). Komatsu: 08:00-08:15, 10:26-10:50 and 12:20-12:43 (loading), and 14:33-15:06 moving rock. Ranges: Hitachi 3.5-4.8 h, Komatsu 1.2-2.0 h. 2 Astra loads (entrance out 10:46 and 12:42; D2_Up shows both being loaded).

d1 up has no footage before 11:09. D2_Up shows the Hitachi starting at about 08:44 and breaking at 09:22-09:26; D2 sees it in the pit 09:26-11:56. Adds about 08:45-11:09 = 2.4 h to d1 up's 3.1 h (range 4.9-5.8 h). Komatsu parked all day: D2's 'loading 09:20-09:24' is wrong, because the Renault tipper left empty (entrance) and D2_Up shows the Komatsu in the same pose 09:22-09:26.
d1 up was complete; D2_Up agrees (Komatsu in the pit 11:57-12:14, Hitachi breaking at 11:35 and 15:54). No change. d1 up's 3-min slot method may overstate this long breaking day by 10-20 %.
Saturday half day. All cameras agree: Komatsu loads at 10:52-11:06 and 12:03-12:18, Hitachi breaking 07:45-12:05. 2 loads (out 11:07 and 12:18).
Sunday. d1 up has no footage before 12:03, but D2 (06:20-18:31) and D2_Up (05:31 and the night events) show both machines in the same pose all day. No work, no trucks.

No change. D2's claim that the Hitachi was breaking from 14:03 is not supported: the D2 originals 14:03-14:38 show its boom in the same pose, which matches d1 up (idle 11:15-14:48, tanker 14:37-14:48). D2's '3 loads' are the same 2 trips (14:03 is truck 2 being filled). The D2-D3 continuous card starts at 19:46.

D2-D3 (continuous) shows the Komatsu making small moves near the camera 08:10-08:50, so part of d1 up's 07:57-08:51 Komatsu block was real; I took the middle of d1 up's 2.5-2.9 range. Hitachi unchanged (calibration 5.1 / 2.5). 4 loads: D2's 5th 'load' at 10:38 is truck 1 being loaded (D2_Up 10:40-10:44; out 10:56).

d1 up recorded only from 14:23. D2-D3 (continuous, close to the pit) gives the morning: Hitachi started 07:50 and broke rock continuously 08:00-11:12; it stood aside at the camera 11:20-11:40, broke 11:45-12:18, stood aside 12:20-12:34, broke 12:35-13:20, and was parked by D2-D3 13:25-15:05 (can episode, operator sitting in the cab), then broke 15:05-15:54. The 16:00-16:57 'breaking' on D2 is not real: D2-D3 and D2_Up show the boom in one pose with surveyors walking around. Komatsu: 07:45-08:05, the 4 loadings (11:13-11:35, 12:17-12:35, 13:20-13:44, 14:23-15:06). Calibration 5.4 / 1.8. 4 loads (entrance out 11:31, 12:35, 13:38, 14:45; D2_Up shows all 4 being loaded).

D2-D3 shows the Komatsu parked beside the camera, in the same pose, 12:10-12:30 and from 14:00 onwards, so d1 up's uncertain Komatsu stretches (12:08-12:34 and 14:00-14:30) were idle and are removed (calibration 2.1). Hitachi unchanged; D2-D3 shows it breaking 08:30-11:20 and 12:20-15:50 and standing aside at the camera 11:30-12:00. 3 loads.

No change. D2_Up shows the Hitachi parked in one pose 14:57-18:30, which covers d1 up's 17:00-18:30 gap; D2's 'probably still working 14:28-16:07' is not supported. Komatsu parked all day on every camera. No tipper on any camera; the only heavy vehicle is the tanker at 17:08 (D3 up).
